This paper proposes a collaborative filtering method that reduces the impact of attacks while maintaining or improving the prediction accuracy by applying clustering to the target data multiple times and predicting the ratings for unrated items inside each cluster. In addition, the usefulness of the method is investigated using an evaluation method that measures the error between actual user ratings and predicted ratings. Furthermore, the robustness against attacks is investigated by comparing the prediction errors before and after attacks.

articleTitle: Improved Hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm Application in Workshop Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of slow convergence rate and local convergence, which belongs to solving the shop scheduling problems by using Particle swarm optimization (pso) algorithm, this paper introduces Chaos Principle, crossover, mutation operation and Neighborhood Search algorithm, as well as combining basic Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm into a Hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm. Because of the combination of the advantages of other algorithms, the ability of particles in the algorithm to break through local solutions is enhanced. The verification of the standard test cases such as FT series and LA series proves the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm and the results are better than other algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Design Method of Inland River Digital Channel Map Based on Baidu Map
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In view of the fact that the existing electronic channel map can't dynamically update the channel elements and the overall navigable area of the channel in real time, the ship driver can't grasp the actual situation of the channel while driving, this paper proposes an inland digital channel design scheme based on Baidu map, namely that digital channel collects GIS geographic information of channel in advance, this scheme dynamically generates the electronic fence of the channel elements in real time, displays the complex navigation environment of the inland river, and uses the Delaunay triangulation and Bezier curve fitting method to obtain the deep line of the channel, combines with the track analyzed by the historical track AIS data. The boundary is obtained from the navigational area of the channel, which can dynamically reflect the navigation information of the inland channel in real time, providing a sufficient basis for the navigation of the ship's pilot.

articleTitle: Development of Visual Guidance System for Automatic Welding of Spiral Track Ribbons in Fried Tea Tube
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Welding automation has become a hot issue in industrial research. Not only the general welding system is developing continuously, but also the special welding system developed for specific weld features are developing rapidly. In this paper, the features of weld forming of fried tea tube were studied. It is known that the weld seam of fried tea tube is irregular inner spiral. Aiming at the features of weld seam, a visual sensor was designed, and active vision method was used to identify weld seam. On this basis, a visual guidance system was established. Linear laser scanning and welding torch following motion were adopted in welding. The point-by-point comparison method was used to extract the weld seam deviation, and the speed compensation method was used to compensate the deviation. In order to verify the accuracy of the visual guidance system, welding experiments were designed and tested. The deviation values of each axis were recorded for data analysis, and the MATLAB was used to perform spiral curve fitting on data. By comparing the fitting effect of data and observing the actual welding effect, it is determined that the visual system can accurately realize the guiding welding of the fried tea tube.

articleTitle: A Trusted Routing Mechanism for Mobile Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In recent years, mobile social networks (MSNs) have developed rapidly and their application fields are becoming more and more widespread. Due to the continuous movement of nodes in mobile social networks, the network topology is very unstable. How to ensure the credibility of network communication is a subject worth studying. In this paper, based on the characteristics of mobile social networks, the definition of trust level is introduced into the DSR routing protocol, and a trusted DSR routing mechanism (TDR) is proposed. The scheme combines the sliding window model to design the calculation method of trust level between nodes and path trust level. The nodes in the network participate in the routing process according to their trust level. When the source node receives multiple routes carried by the response, the appropriate trusted path is selected according to the path trust level. Through simulation analysis, compared with the original DSR protocol, the TDR protocol improves the performance of average delay, route cost and packet delivery fraction, and verifies the reliability and credibility of the TDR protocol.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Research of a Novel Multi-Port Modular Energy Router
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Based on the convenient access provided by the micro-distributed power supply and power electronic control technology, design schemes for energy router frame distributed power supply and AC/DC load access are proposed. Based on the overall regulation strategy of energy integration, the overall control structure of the energy router is given. Meanwhile, grid-connected, off-grid and switching processes are simulated in the Matlab/Simulink environment, which vindicates the feasibility of the control method and parameter selection. The users' specific requirements for the quantity and quality of power can be satisfied and can therefore achieve desirable operational reliability and economical efficiency.

articleTitle: A Novel Registration Method for Robot-assisted Percutaneous Vertebroplasty
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Traditional percutaneous vertebroplasty (PVP) could induce massive radiation and side injuries to the tissues or nerves around the fractured centrum for an inaccurate route plan. Hence, robot-assisted percutaneous vertebroplasty was gradually adopted to help surgeons give an accurate route plan for PVP. Before the route plan and surgery, it should finish registration first, that is, the relationship of the coordinates system between assisted robot and three-dimension (3-D) reconstruction image of vertebral should be established. In this paper, a novel registration method was proposed for robot-assisted Percutaneous Vertebroplasty. Some targets were affixed near the lesion area of the patient's skin. Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM) files taken from Computed Tomography (CT) were used to 3-D reconstruct the patient's vertebral and these targets. The relationship of coordinates was established by Helmert transformation with the coordinate values of these targets. Experiments were carried out on a section of sheep's vertebral and the performance was evaluated.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Storing the Completed Planning Surveying Results Based on ArcEngine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The completed planning surveying results are an important basis for the supervision and inspection of construction projects by the planning management department. With the continuous development of urban construction, the completed planning surveying results are increasing year by year, which is very important to achieve the unified management of historical completion data and newly added completion data. In order to solve the problems of a single and tedious way of data storage, repeated input of data and low efficiency of data integration in actual production, this paper puts forward a technique method of quickly importing the results data into the database. Based on the design of geographic information database, this method analyzes the storage mechanism of data in its geographic information database and standardizes data format. Then, through ArcEngine programming, the automation of reading, importing and associating the data of various measurement results has been realized. It is proved by actual production and application that this method improves the working efficiency and reduces the project cost, and it also has practical reference value for the management of other surveying and mapping achievements.

articleTitle: Improved Quality Aware Network Using Quality and Max Pooling Based Late Feature Fusion for Video-Based Person Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Video-based person re-identification is an important research area in computer vision. Quality Aware Network (QAN) is a model that is robust to noise in the videos. It calculates the weighted average of all the frames' image features, with each frame's quality score as the weight, and generates a video feature. However, the QAN has poor ability to distinguish pedestrians with highly similar clothing. To address this problem, we analyze the advantages and shortcomings of Quality Pooling and Max Pooling in theory, and propose the Frame Quality and Max Pooling based Late Feature Fusion Method (QMFF). It aims at enhancing the QAN's ability to distinguish pedestrians with similar clothing. First, use Quality Pooling to get the initial ranking list. Then, for each Query, judge whether the top-N candidates in the ranking list are highly similar in clothing to one another. If the Query meets the similarity criterion, Max Pooling with Frame Quality Filter is used. Local salient features selected by Max Pooling help distinguish pedestrians more accurately. Experimental results on the iLIDS-VID dataset show that the proposed method is superior to the QAN and many recently proposed methods.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Long-short-term Memory Network in Human Morphology Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: With behavior recognition technology playing an increasingly important role in many fields such as intelligent monitoring, human-computer interaction, video sequence understanding, medical and health care, researchers are trying to improve the accuracy of behavior recognition technology. By combining LSTM with GRU, this paper simplifies the network structure on the basis of retaining the basic idea of LSTM (forgetting and updating mechanism), and uses update gate to make each unit learn long-term and short-term characteristics, thus reducing the risk of gradient dispersion. Experiments show that this optimization method has better resolution than traditional LSTM.

articleTitle: Sub-lens System based on Dispersion Phenomenon of LED Integral Imaging
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: It is usual problem that the chromatic dispersion and crosstalk in the LED integral imaging naked-eye stereo display because one pixel in the color LED display is composed of three primary colors. By analyzing the luminescent property of LED and the spatial distribution functions, a sub-lens system to solve the problem of light divergence in optical reconstruction is proposed in this paper. The element image(EI) is improved at the sub-pixel level according to the pixel relationship between adjacent micro-lenses of LED integral imaging. The sub-lens design and the corresponding sub-pixel rearrangement theory are proposed, and the mapping relationship from the conventional pixel arrangement to the sub-pixel arrangement is calculated. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively solve the dispersion, reduce the crosstalk between pixels, and improve the display quality of the reconstructed light field.

articleTitle: Robust Acoustic Source Localization Method based on Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In this paper, Compressed sensing theory is applied to the acoustic source of microphone array, and a new high precision and robust sound source localization method is proposed. The proposed method firstly compresses the signal with a random compressed matrix and then estimates the directions of arrival by OMP algorithm. From the simulation results, the algorithm has the advantages of super-resolution and high accuracy, and is superior to MUSIC algorithm in sampling number and anti-noise, etc.

articleTitle: EDGEGAT: An Approach to Add External Knowledge for Semantic Matching
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Natural Language Inference (NLI) is one of NLP tasks to deduce, given a premise, whether a relevant hypothesis should be declared true or false. In view of the performance of previous models, the improvement provided by external knowledge is substantial. Inspired by it, we propose a new mechanism for introducing external knowledge, i.e., adding the graph convolutional network (EDGEGAT) we designed to the NLI model. Unlike previous external knowledge methods, EDGEGAT can easily be combined with NLI models and automatically learn to filter and utilize the knowledge graph during training. Using this mechanism we show significant improvement in performance for previous NLI models with Stanford Natural Language Inference (SNLI) dataset. Moreover, we demonstrate that EDGEGAT is effective and more suitable for knowledge graphs than the previous graph convolution network.

articleTitle: Research on Unit Combination for Electric Vehicles Charging Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: As a new type of vehicle, electric vehicles can improve energy efficiency and reduce environmental pollution. However, as a special load, the charging behavior of electric vehicles is random and intermittent. In this paper, the genetic algorithm is used to solve the charging and discharging constraints of electric vehicles. Taking the lowest cost as the objective function, a combined start and stop model oflarge-scale electric vehicle charging and discharging considering multiple constraints is established, and the optimal combination and minimum power generation cost are obtained. The common algorithms of unit commitment are also introduced. Genetic algorithm is used to solve complex nonlinear optimization problems. Multiple constraints and special requirements for objective functions can be considered. With Matlab and finite iteration, the optimal solution and generating unit output are solved for a specific example, and a set of optimal start - stop combinations in a group of 24 hours is obtained.

articleTitle: Study on Large-scale Failure Recovery Mechanism of Optical Transport Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: A recovery scheme of multi-failure about the Improved Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm Based on Two-Dimensional Space (IACO-2D) algorithm is proposed. This scheme mainly has an intensive study on Routing and Wavelength Assignment (RWA) algorithm based on the first failure scenario. In this scheme, the problem of wavelength assignment is solved by First Fit (FF) algorithm. And the problem of routing is solved by IACO-2D algorithm. In IACO-2D algorithm, the theory of Maklink's graph is used to construct a two-dimensional planning space. By improving the transition probability of the traditional Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) algorithm, the network can select a low-occupancy link with higher probability when routing. The simulation assumes two failure scenarios. Compared with the ACO algorithm, IACO-2D algorithm improves the ratios of resource utilization by 25.46%,23.18<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>respectively. And the ratios of blocking are made decrease by 16.46% and 15.16% respectively.

articleTitle: Cloud-based Adaptive Quantum Genetic Algorithm for Solving Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The quantum genetic algorithm is improved for the flexible shop scheduling problem. In this paper, a quantum genetic algorithm adaptively adjusting the rotation angle is designed to solve the flexible shop scheduling problem. The randomness and stability tendency of the cloud model are used to adaptively adjust the rotation angle to improve the optimization ability of the algorithm. At the same time, quantum crossover and quantum variability are used to improve population diversity and prevent premature convergence. Numerical experiments show that the algorithm has good performance.

articleTitle: Research on Short Duration Wind Power Variation Characteristics of GuiZhou Province and Fast Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In the wind-rich areas, such as Guizhou Province, it brought a lot of adverse effects on frequency, stabilization and so on, because of the wind's randomness and Guizhou's special characteristics of mountain wind power. Base on this case, the paper researches the statistic characteristics of wind power, and raises a fast control strategy of the integration of wind and small hydropower. This strategy uses adjustable small hydropower to coordinate with wind power and to response to the control of AGC. The influence on system frequency and transmission power of tie line made by wind power can be reduced. The specific model and real data of GuiZhou provincial power grid are applieed in the paper to verify the feasibility and validity of the method.

articleTitle: An AVLC Markov Model Based on Send Window
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Different from the current researches of focusing on the output data-stream, the paper establishes an AVLC\HDLC model in view of the send-window for the first time. In the process of modeling, we firstly take the current window location as the stochastic process X(t) and verify that it constitutes a continuous-time Markov chain. Then, based on the assumptions abstracted from AVLC protocol, we analyze and get the transition probability matrix. Furthermore, the matrix can be simplified through neglecting transmission time. Therefore, X(t) can be specialized as homogeneous Markov chain. As a result, we can deduce the transition probability density matrix and build the Fokker-Planck equation, from which the probability at final state can be solved. Finally, on the basic of targets definition, calculation method of the performance is achieved. Simulation experiments manifest that the model has its internal rationality and can be applied in AVLC performance estimation.

articleTitle: Performance of Fiber Reinforced Composite Strengthened Concrete Interface
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The finite element method was adopted for investigation, the effects on the performance of the fiber reinforced polymer composite materials strengthened concrete structure. The finite element formula was conducted in terms of Mindlin first order shear deformational theory. And then the effects of the bond layer length, the width and numbers of bond layers adhesive fiber reinforced polymer on the the interfacial performance were discussed. Numerical results show that bond layer parameters of FRP strengthened concrete interface can affect adhesive performance.

articleTitle: Severe Patients Shock Detection Model Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Medical research has shown that the prolongation of Capillary Refilling Time (CRT) is significantly associated with the shock caused by various pathogenesis, and the shock detected in critically ill patients as earlier as possible has important clinical significance. Utilizing capillary refill time measuring instruments, we can implement standardized and mechanized measurement of CRT, and get stable and reliable photoplethysmogram (PPG) raw signal data of CRT. However, there are many challenges in extracting clinical parameters from PPG raw signal data and analyzing the shock occurs or not depending on these parameters, such as great affection by noise, poor ability to cope with variations, and underutilization of raw data. To cope with these challenges, we propose an end-to-end shock detection model based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). In this paper, the convolutional kernel of dense neural network and mathematical network are proposed innovatively. Our shock detection model achieves 0.89 F1-Score using clinical CRT data, which can provide direct and exact medical verdict indicating the patient be in shock or not, which has clinical value.

articleTitle: Linear Optimal Filter for Stochastic Uncertain systems with Multi-loss Packets and Finite-step Delays
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: This paper studies the linear optimal filter for networked control systems owning non-stationary observations noise. Taking phenomena of multi-loss packets and finite-step delay and uncertain parameters of the networked control systems into consideration, the model of multi-loss packets and finite-step delays are represented by a set of Bernoulli stochastic variables. The parameters uncertainties are depicted by multiplying the white noise sequence. In order to facilitate the derivation of the optimal linear filter, we first perform model transformation. Then the linear optimal filter with linear minimum variance meaning is developed via the projection theory and the innovation analysis technique. A numerical simulation illustrates that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of the Unloading Process of Material Suction and Exhaust Truck Based on Euler Double Fluid Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: The simulation analysis of the unloading process of the material suction and exhaust truck is of great significance for improving the quality and efficiency of material unloading. This paper takes a certain type of powder material suction and exhaust tank as the research object, and adopts Euler model to establish the material-air dual fluid model. The 3D fluidization model and 2D fluidization model of the tank were established by using ANSYS FLUENT as the simulation platform. The separation solver is used for transient solution. The process of material suction and discharge is simulated. The simulation results show that the double Euler model is suitable for the simulation of the unloading process of the suction and discharge truck, and the material in the tank is fluidized evenly.

articleTitle: Research on Parallel Discrete Event Simulation Method for Complex Information Network of Satellite Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: With the continuous deepening of the modeling, simulation and optimization applications of satellite navigation systems, there is an increasing demand for computing power. The method of improving the calculation ability by increasing the main frequency is difficult to meet the requirements of the top-level optimization design and simulation verification of the system. By means of the basic theory of parallel computing of navigation complex information network and the key technology of CPU multi-core parallel simulation engine, the simulation running state equivalent to the actual system can be designed efficiently as simulation operation scene of the experiment.

articleTitle: A New Real-Time Fire Detection Method Based On Infrared Image
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: In this paper, a new flame detection method using infrared images is proposed. By analyzing the spectrum of the sun, a 940nm narrow-band filter is applied to the camera to obtain an infrared image. Then, a threshold selection method for the flame is applied to obtain the binarized image, and then the similarity of consecutive video frames and the roundness of the contour are used to make the final judgment. Experimental results demonstrated that the proposed method has the advantages of high speed, low cost, and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Fast Motion Estimation Method for Self-driving Video
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: As auto-driving cars become increasingly dependent on computer vision technology, the storage and real-time transmission problems of massive videos from self-driving cars follow. Efficient coding technology helps to save storage space and increase transmission speed. However, the current encoding time is still too long to meet the speed requirements of video storage and transmission in self-driving cars. Under this circumstance, this paper proposed a fast motion estimation method for self- driving scene videos called DFME. It is an algorithm based on the regulars in driving scene videos. Such regular makes it possible to simplify the model prediction, motion vector prediction, and motion vector search process. It has been proved in experiments on HEVC that the method DFME can reduce 30% encoding time on average with less than 1% PSNR lost for self-driving scene videos in Kitti data set.

articleTitle: Encrypted Traffic Classification Based on Text Convolution Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Traffic classification is of great significance to network management. With the wide application of encryption technology, traditional traffic classification methods are no longer applicable. In recent years, the machine learning-based traffic classification method has become more and more popular. However, this method not only needs complex feature engineering but also is difficult to adapt to different network environments. A traffic classification method based on text convolution neural network is proposed in this paper, which represents traffic data as vectors, then use text convolution neural networks to extract key features for traffic classification. This method is validated on ISCX VPN-non VPN dataset and achieves better classification performance than the previous traffic classification method. For class imbalance problem, a new loss function and an appropriate method of class weight allocation are used in multi-class classification task, which can effectively deal with class imbalance problem.

articleTitle: An Autonomous Planning Method for UAV Based on Behavior-Conditional Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and intelligent technology, the future environment of battlefield is being complex and changeable. The traditional use way of UAV based on pre-planning is difficult to meet the basic needs, especially to deal with battlefield emergencies. In order to solve this problem, this paper takes the application of Rule-based Modeling Method in autonomous mission planning of UAV as the research object, and simplifies it into Behavior- Conditional Model by using Rule-based Modeling Method. Through the analysis and modeling of Behavior-Conditional Rules, detailed rules describing various common task patterns are established, and task operation behavior rules and priority decision rules of task objectives are formulated. In summary, an autonomous decision-making method based on rule reasoning is formed. Finally, the method of random generation of threat sources is used to simulate the actual combat environment. By evaluating the effects of rule-based and irregular deduction, simulation experiments verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the Rule-based Modeling Method, and the experimental results are satisfactory.

articleTitle: Gradient-Based Differential Privacy Optimizer for Deep Learning Model Using Collaborative Training Mode
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Deep learning model based on artificial neural network is one of the greatest pushers to realize intelligence of information system unprecedentedly. However, the risk of leaking user data privacy by attacking deep learning model exists in the training process, especially when multi-users concurrently utilize the service of cloud. Motivated by this observation, in order to protect the privacy of deep learning model, this paper proposes a gradient-based differential privacy optimizer using collaborative training mode based on CPU-GPUs hybrid system in cloud. In gradient-based differential privacy optimizer, random sampling, gradient tailoring, gradient-based random perturbation, and advanced privacy budget statistics together guarantee the usability and privacy of the model. Specifically, the effects of privacy budget, noise scale, and privacy deviation parameters and their combinations on accuracy of model are experimentally studied in this paper. To further improve the training efficiency of model, the CPU-GPUs hybrid system is explored as a collaborative training mode for gradient-based differential privacy optimizer. The experimental results indicate that using publicly available dataset MINIST and implemented in TensorFlow is proved to be feasible and efficient. Specifically, our implementation and experiments demonstrate that we can obtain approximately 96% of accuracy under a modest privacy budget. Furthermore, we can achieve up to 20%-30% speed-up ratio in the training process based on gradient-based differential privacy optimizer.

articleTitle: A Trend Prediction Method for Failures Time Series Data by Exploring Singular Spectrum Analysis and Support Vector Machines Regression
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Recently, reliability prediction problems have been sufficiently studied by applying various failures time series prediction models. However, these models' performance could easily reach the bottleneck on account of the noise interference of the failures data. This paper focuses on the trend component of failures time series data as we believe its noiseless curve will achieve better prediction results and help to provide scientific guidance for reliability activities. We propose a trend prediction method which mainly involves two steps, trend extraction by singular spectrum analysis (SSA) and noise test, and trend prediction by support vector machines regression (SVR). Moreover, we further develop a multi-layer grid search algorithm to obtain optimized parameters of SSA and SVR models. The performance of the proposed method is measured against other time series processing techniques such as seasonal-trend decomposition procedure based on loess (STL), Holt-Winters, autoregressive moving average (ARMA), multiple linear regression (MLR) and k-nearest neighbors (KNN). The comparison results indicate that the proposed method outperforms other techniques and can be utilized as a promising tool for failures time series trend prediction.

articleTitle: Flow Shop Scheduling Problem with Limited Buffer Based on Hybrid Shuffled Frog Leaping Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Aiming at the flow shop scheduling problem with limited buffer, a hybrid shuffled frog-leaping algorithm (HSFLA) combining variable neighborhood search (VNS) and frog-leaping algorithm (SFLA) is proposed to minimize the makespan. To improve the quality of the initial solutions, a partial initial population is generated using the NEH algorithm and iterative greedy (IG). In order to avoid the problem of the original algorithm's premature convergence and producing infeasible solutions, the adaptive moving operator is introduced to improve the step size and crossover operator in the sub-population's updating part. A variable neighborhood search method based on three neighborhood structures is designed to enhance the local optimization ability of the algorithm. The performances of HSFLA were evaluated over car and rec benchmark problems. The computational results demonstrated that HSFLA has an effective performance for the flow shop scheduling problem with limited buffer.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning for Airport Detection Based on Saliency Fusion of Parallel Lines and Regions of Interest
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Most existing airport detection methods for remote sensing image utilizes linear features of the airport runway insufficiently, and the computational complexity is high due to multi-scale anchor matching and global searching within full image. To solve this problem, an airport detection method based on saliency fusion of parallel lines and regions of interest is presented in this paper. Firstly the parallelism feature of the airport runway is extracted based on the prior knowledge of airport, and then regions of interest (ROI) is obtained according to the improved graph based visual saliency (GBVS). The airport is then located through the saliency fusion of parallel lines and regions of interest. Finally airport detection is achieved by transfer learning. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method is more advantageous than the comparison algorithms in terms of detection accuracy, processing speed, and false alarm rate. Moreover, the method only requires a small amount of samples for model training.

articleTitle: Vertex Degree Aware Two-Stage Graph Partitioning for Distributed Data-Flow Computing of Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: To solve the data-flow graph partitioning problem of deep learning in distributed architecture, this paper presents a vertex degree aware two-stage graph partitioning method. At first stage, a vertex degree aware method is designed to preliminarily partition data-flow graph; at second stage, a fuzzy clustering based edge re-distributing algorithm is formulated for load balancing across computing nodes. Combining two stages, the framework of the two-stage method is constructed. Theoretical analysis demonstrates that the proposed method can achieve smaller upper bound of communication cost than comparison methods. Experimental results validate that the proposed method outperforms comparison methods in terms of replication factor, edge imbalance and execution time of data-flow graph computing.

articleTitle: Dynamic Look-up Table Method for Optimizing the Training of Deep Neural Networks on Many-Core Architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: Due to the excessive training parameters and computation of Deep Neural Network (DNN) models, we have witnessed the training time increases with the continued increase of the scale of DNN models. Convolution computation is the key step of feature extraction in DNN models and occupies about 90% of the computation operations in DNN models. It is therefore of great necessity to accelerate the speed of convolution calculation in order to improve the training efficiency of system. Currently, the traditional method is to transform convolution computation into matrix multiplication and execute on many-core architecture such as Graphic Processing Unit (GPU). However, due to matrix conversion and high computational complexity of matrix multiplication, these methods based on matrix multiplication such as Caffe, consume a lot of time in accessing memory and need to copy redundant data in process of matrix conversion. The low capacity of GPU memory further leads to the low training efficiency of DNN models. Therefore, we orchestrate a dynamic look-up table method instead of matrix multiplication to realize convolution calculation in order to optimize the training of DNN on many-core architecture. We further improve the parallelism of the look-up table method in a more fine-grained parallelism by paralleling the building convolution table and look-up table operation based on GPU. In our experiment, we tested and trained MINIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet data sets respectively. Experiments show that, compared to the original Caffe, the proposed dynamic look-up table method referred as LTP-Caffe can achieve up to 31% speed-up ratio in the training process of DNN models. Experiments further show that LTP-Caffe and Caffe are comparable in accuracy, but the iteration speed of LTP-Caffe is more quickly than the Caffe.

articleTitle: Discrete Glowworm Swarm Optimization Algorithm With Key Strategy Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: A discrete glowworm swarm optimization algorithm with key strategy adjustment (KSA-DGSO) is proposed to solve the problems that the current discrete glowworm swarm optimization algorithm (DGSO) is lack of application features combined with practical problem, rigorous and accurate scientific basis, which is caused by updating the position of the individual glowworm according as the random probability. The KSA-DGSO algorithm is applied to search for the optimal control strategy of complex network security risk. The position update mechanism of the algorithm is reset according to the change case of the objective function with the key strategy, which prevent the algorithm into the local stalemate or cause a poor accuracy. The experiment results show that the optimal objective function is average reduced by about 2.55%-4.83% with the KSA-DGSO algorithm than the DGSO algorithm, and the optimal iteration number is average reduced by about 9.85%-12.80%. The superiority of the KSA-DGSO algorithm is validated by simulations, and the effect of the change for the control parameters to the complex network security risk optimal control is further analyzed from the simulated results.

articleTitle: Fine-grained Image Caption based on Multi-level Attention
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computer Science and Network Technology (ICCSNT)
abstract: With the continuous development of image caption, the effects of it are getting better. However, there are still problems with the image caption. The complete description should contain different forms of information which include fine-grained information and labels. In order to cope with the above challenges, we propose a fine-grained image caption based on multi-level attention method which can complete label prediction and description of fine-grained images. (1)We firstly use the visual attention mechanism to fuse features of the global and local fine-grained features. (2)The joint attention mechanism is then used to fuse the visual feature and the label features of the image to generate a text description for a specific region of the image. (3)Finally, we use the attention-based Long Short Term Memory (LSTM), a language generation model, to generate fine-grained image caption.
